agendaItems.title:
Discuss of Memorandum of Understanding regarding the Tampa Bay Rays.

- 30 minutes presentation from the Tampa Bay Rays. 

- 30 minutes presentation by the City . 

- 30 minutes - Question and Answer Session.

- 5 minutes for each invited stakeholder.

- 30 minutes - Additional Q&A.


Memorandum from John Bennett, Chief of Staff, transmitting additional documents that were previously provided to City Council. (To be R/F)

Memorandum from John Bennett, Chief of Staff, transmitting a presentation for said discussion. (To be R/F)
